spindle.observe.AnswerSource.title: AnswerSource
spindle.observe.AnswerSource.description: What answered one external cause of a served command. `world`: the decision table of the last reset's world. `file`: the decisions file. `default`: the default branch `--answer-default` takes. `unanswered`: nothing did, and the command answered `501`.

spindle.observe.EdgeTraffic.title: EdgeTraffic
spindle.observe.EdgeTraffic.description: The live numbers of one edge since the run started, read from the counters `GET /__spindle/metrics` exposes and the ring `GET /__spindle/requests` holds.

count.description: Requests a `routes` edge handed on, events an `emits` edge emitted, envelopes a `carries` edge sent, commands an `invokes` edge invoked, questions an `asks` edge asked.

statuses.description: For a `routes` edge, the count per status class; empty for every other kind.

sources.description: For an `asks` edge, the count per answer source; empty for every other kind.

latest.description: For a `routes` edge, the sequences of its latest requests still in the ring, newest first, at most 5; each names a record of `GET /__spindle/requests`.

spindle.observe.SourceCount.title: SourceCount
spindle.observe.SourceCount.description: How many times one source answered the external cause an `asks` edge leads to.

spindle.observe.StatusClass.title: StatusClass
spindle.observe.StatusClass.description: The class of an HTTP status by its first digit, as the `status_class` label of `spindle_http_requests_total` writes it.

spindle.observe.StatusCount.title: StatusCount
spindle.observe.StatusCount.description: How many requests of one status class an edge carried since the run started.
